title: ORDER FOR EMERGENCY MEASURES
full_text:
■ Enforcement Rule of the Prevention of Steep Slope Disasters Act [Attached Form 4] <Amended 2017.7.3>

ORDER FOR EMERGENCY MEASURES

| Section | Field | Entry |
|---|---|---|
| Person to receive the order | Name | ____________________ |
| | Date of birth | ____________________ |
| | Address | ____________________ (Telephone: ____________________) |
| Summary of the order for emergency measures | Grounds for the order | ____________________ |
| | Details of emergency measures | ____________________ |
| | Period of participation | ____________________ |
| | Place of participation | ____________________ |
| | Other matters | ____________________ |

Pursuant to Article 19(1) of the Prevention of Steep Slope Disasters Act, Article 9(1) of the Enforcement Decree of that Act, and Article 7(1) of the Enforcement Rule of that Act, you are hereby ordered to participate in the emergency measures stated above. Your cooperation is requested.

Year _____ Month _____ Day _____

Special Self-Governing City Mayor
Head of Si/Gun/Gu
[Official seal]

[Cut along this line]

ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF RECEIPT OF AN ORDER FOR EMERGENCY MEASURES

Serial number: ____________________
Name: ____________________    Date of birth: ____________________
Address: ____________________

I confirm receipt of the written order for emergency measures for the above person.

Recipient's name: ____________________
(Relationship: the person's ____________________)
(Signature or seal)
